pkgmetadata.longdescription:
SoftMaker Office 2024 is a commercial, perpetually licensed office suite by SoftMaker Software GmbH: the TextMaker word processor, the PlanMaker spreadsheet and the Presentations slide software, with native support for Microsoft Office file formats. It needs a purchased product key; a trial key is available from the vendor.
The suite installs to /opt/softmaker-office and can coexist with app-office/freeoffice. Launchers: softmaker-office-textmaker, softmaker-office-planmaker, softmaker-office-presentations, plus the upstream names textmaker24, planmaker24 and presentations24.
